mechanism: Two moving carriers share a clear travel axis while their relative vertical gap narrows and then widens. Spatially legible near-miss tension depends on co-direction, persistent geography, visible clearance and non-contact resolution, not a specific failure cause.

invariants.rule: Establish exactly two distinct moving carriers on one stable co-directional route.
invariants.purpose: Makes relative distance meaningful across views.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opposing travel axes or duplicate vehicles make the near-miss geometry incoherent.

invariants.rule: Show the gap changing while both carriers and a stable environmental reference remain legible; preserve non-contact clearance.
invariants.purpose: Provides a visible spatial cause for tension.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close-up with no shared scale or apparent collision cannot prove a near miss.

invariants.rule: End in a wide enough view to prove increased separation on the same route.
invariants.purpose: Closes the spatial question without an invented impact.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending during the tight gap leaves the outcome unresolved.

slots.name: lower_carrier
slots.constraint: One original lower moving unit with stable silhouette and route.

slots.name: upper_carrier
slots.constraint: One original higher moving unit with stable altitude relation; must never contact lower one.

slots.name: environment
slots.constraint: Stable route, direction and side landmarks.

slots.name: gap_event
slots.constraint: One readable narrowing with a clear minimum safe distance.

slots.name: separation
slots.constraint: Visible restoration of vertical gap and shared forward direction.

slots.name: camera
slots.constraint: Establish shared axis, prove closest gap, then hold wide separation.

slots.name: sound
slots.constraint: Original sound may follow relative motion, not attributed to unheard source audio.

anti_copy_exclusions: No red numbered race car, black helicopter, mountain track or exact vehicle livery and camera positions.
Do not copy the source snapshot's unverified power-loss explanation or treat the excerpt as a complete original prompt.
No crash, real passenger peril or false precise distance claim.

instantiations.concept: A mountain cable car and small maintenance airship move toward the same upper station; the airship dips then restores a visible safe air gap.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original closed-route mountain maintenance test, blue cable car below amber airship, one station axis, non-contact dip and wide separation proof.

instantiations.concept: A miniature stop-motion freight trolley and motorized overhead bridge crane travel together down one factory aisle; the crane hook descends close to the trolley roof, stops, then rises while both continue away.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original stop-motion factory set, one small trolley and one traveling overhead bridge crane on the same aisle axis, readable minimum gap and wide safe resolution.

failure_modes.failure: Upper carrier appears to reverse or swap sides between shots.
failure_modes.repair: Keep fixed route landmarks and the same direction vector in every view.

failure_modes.failure: At closest approach, one carrier disappears or appears to intersect the other.
failure_modes.repair: Use a shared-profile view showing both boundaries and a visible air gap.

failure_modes.failure: Ending shows impact or cuts away before separation.
failure_modes.repair: Hold a wide final geometry with both carriers on the original route and a wider gap.
